snippet.title: Official Trailer | Delicious - Emily's Home Sweet Home
snippet.description:
Discover Delicious - Emily's Home Sweet Home and help the O'Malleys fix up their dream house! Play it on your computer, iPhone, iPad, or Android phones and tablets! After a warm welcome, some neighbors reveal a different nature. A turbulent time follows in which Emily and Patrick must go above and beyond to stop their house being condemned. A house is a house, but can you help them make it home? ►►►Play now! http://m.onelink.me/f09998b9
